verdict.rationale: There is documented ability to cancel/revoke a purchase-intent mandate ("Your agent can cancel a purchase intent when the customer chooses to not make the purchase") which is a rudimentary rollback mechanism, but no evidence of versioning of automations/mandates or any review/audit UI for past instructions beyond dispute-resolution signal capture. missing for 10: mandate/instruction versioning, a review interface or history log for agent automations, broader rollback beyond single purchase-intent cancellation.
